title: NATIONAL HERITAGE PRESERVATION FUND ACT
full_text:
NATIONAL HERITAGE PRESERVATION FUND ACT

Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Act is to establish the National Heritage Preservation Fund to raise funds necessary for the efficient preservation and management of national heritage and to prescribe matters necessary for its management and operation. <Amended on Aug. 8, 2023>

Article 2 (Definitions) The terms used in this Act mean the following:
1. "National heritage" means national heritage under Article 3 of the Framework Act on National Heritage.
2. "Designated cultural heritage" means designated cultural heritage under Article 2 (3) of the Act on the Preservation and Utilization of Cultural Heritage.
3. "Natural monuments, etc." means natural monuments, etc. under subparagraph 5 of Article 2 of the Act on the Preservation and Utilization of Natural Heritage.

Article 3 (Establishment of Fund) The Government shall establish the National Heritage Preservation Fund (hereinafter referred to as the "Fund") in order to secure financial resources necessary for the preservation and management of national heritage. <Amended on Aug. 8, 2023>

Article 4 (Creation of Fund)
(1) The Fund shall be created from the following resources:
1. Contributions from the Government;
2. Cash, goods, and other property contributed or donated by persons other than the Government;
3. Money transferred from the Lottery Fund under the Lottery Tickets and Lottery Fund Act;
4. Payments under paragraph (2);
5. Revenue from the operation of the Fund;
6. Other revenues prescribed by Presidential Decree.
(2) The State and local governments that collect admission fees for designated cultural heritage under Articles 49 and 74 of the Act on the Preservation and Utilization of Cultural Heritage, or admission fees for natural monuments, etc. under Article 63 of the Act on the Preservation and Utilization of Natural Heritage, shall pay 10 percent of the amounts collected into the Fund. <Amended on Feb. 3, 2016; Aug. 8, 2023>
(3) Persons making contributions or donations under paragraph (1) 2 may designate their use for supporting specific national heritage. <Amended on Aug. 8, 2023>
(4) Matters necessary for the procedures and methods for collecting payments under paragraph (2), the timing of payment, and submission of materials relating to receipt of payments shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 5 (Uses of Fund) The Fund shall be used for any of the following purposes: <Amended on Feb. 3, 2016; Dec. 20, 2016; May 18, 2021; Aug. 8, 2023>
1. Preventive management for the preservation of national heritage;
2. Emergency repair or restoration of national heritage due to damage, loss, or similar causes;
3. Small-scale or emergency excavation of buried heritage;
4. Compensation for losses under subparagraphs 1 and 3;
5. Fostering and supporting private-sector national heritage protection activities;
6. Support for operating expenses of organizations researching policies on the preservation, management, and safety of national heritage;
7. Investigation of and research on undesignated national heritage, such as abandoned temple sites under Article 13 (1) 3 of the Act on the Protection and Investigation of Buried Heritage;
8. Emergency purchase of important national heritage located in Korea or abroad;
9. Support for other projects or activities prescribed by Presidential Decree for the preservation and management of national heritage.

Article 6 (Management and Operation of Fund)
(1) The Fund shall be managed and operated by the Administrator of the Korea Heritage Service. <Amended on Feb. 13, 2024>
(2) The Administrator of the Korea Heritage Service may entrust all or part of the duties concerning the management and operation of the Fund, as prescribed by Presidential Decree, to the Korea Heritage Agency established under Article 32 of the Framework Act on National Heritage or a corporation designated by the Administrator. <Amended on May 28, 2014; Aug. 8, 2023; Feb. 13, 2024>
(3) Other matters necessary for the management and operation of the Fund shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 7 (National Heritage Preservation Fund Deliberative Committee)
(1) A National Heritage Preservation Fund Deliberative Committee (hereinafter referred to as the "Committee") shall be established under the Administrator of the Korea Heritage Service to deliberate on the following matters concerning the management and operation of the Fund: <Amended on Dec. 21, 2021; Aug. 8, 2023; Feb. 13, 2024>
1. Major policies on the management and operation of the Fund;
2. Formulation of a draft fund operation plan under Article 66 of the National Finance Act;
3. Changes to expenditure amounts for major items under Article 70 (2) of the National Finance Act;
4. Preparation of a fund performance report under Article 85-6 (1) of the National Finance Act and a fund settlement report under Article 73 of that Act;
5. Important matters concerning the management and operation of the Fund prescribed by Presidential Decree, and other matters that the chairperson considers necessary and submits to a meeting.
(2) At least half of the members of the Committee, including the chairperson, shall be commissioned from among persons who are neither public officials nor persons affiliated with national heritage protection organizations. <Amended on Aug. 8, 2023>
(3) The composition and operation of the Committee and other necessary matters shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 8 (Fiscal Year of Fund) The fiscal year of the fund shall conform to the fiscal year of the government.

Article 9 (Accounting of Fund) The accounting of the fund shall be conducted pursuant to the accounting principles of enterprises.

Article 10 (Accounting Officers of Fund) The Administrator of the Korea Heritage Service shall appoint a fund revenue collection officer, a fund financial officer, a fund expenditure officer, and a fund receipts and disbursements official from among affiliated public officials to perform duties relating to the revenue and expenditure of the Fund. <Amended on Feb. 13, 2024>

Article 11 (Establishment of Fund Account) The Administrator of the Korea Heritage Service shall require the fund expenditure officer to establish an account for the Fund at the Bank of Korea. <Amended on Feb. 13, 2024>

Article 12 (Prohibition on Use for Other Purposes)
(1) No recipient of support from the Fund shall use it for a purpose other than that specified when the support was provided.
(2) If support from the Fund is used for another purpose, the Administrator of the Korea Heritage Service shall revoke the support and recover the funds. <Amended on Feb. 13, 2024>

Article 13 (Deeming Persons Public Officials for Application of Penal Provisions) Executives and employees of a corporation performing duties concerning the management and operation of the Fund entrusted under Article 6 (2) shall be deemed public officials for the application of the penal provisions of Articles 129 through 132 of the Criminal Act. <Amended on Aug. 8, 2023>
